title: CAE Simulation of Thermodynamic Temperature Phenomena During Battery Cell Discharging a CAFICO Battery Box and Comparison with Experimental Measurements
abstract: <jats:p>This paper presents the collaboration of the members of the research team involved in the TAČR project TM03000010 (acronym CAFICO) [1-6]. Verification of the functional properties of current structural designs is a prerequisite for successful development and subsequent production of products in any industry. Current development, including innovation, cannot do without the use of simulation methods and CAE technologies. However, their use is based on the knowledge and experience of the research team, including respect for the results of physical experiments, without which proper product development cannot be achieved.</jats:p>
